title: Windows wheel cache lock
text: Close processes holding wheel files, clear only the package-manager cache, and retry the locked installation.

title: Supported Python versions
text: Version 2 requires Python 3.12 or newer. Confirm the active interpreter before upgrading.

title: Configuration key rename
text: Version 3 renamed server.host to api.host. Replace the old environment key before startup.

title: Authentication troubleshooting
text: A 401 response means the credential is missing, expired, or scoped for another repository. Never include the token in an issue.

title: Repeatable dependency installs
text: Use the committed lock file and a clean environment to distinguish dependency drift from application defects.
